policy: Scholarly map POINT and text garrison status may trigger a new research candidate, not a retroactive year-end active military point without chronology. No speculative polygons, no whole-county English shading.

new_source_registry.title: McNeill & MacQueen (eds.), An Atlas of Scottish History to 1707, maps pp127–128, 1996
new_source_registry.review: Original page 127 indexed transcription and page 128 legend checked, original official 2026 digitization found, reproducing images subject to licence
not_reliable_for: without verification ambiguous 1549 vs 1550 Broughty date

new_source_registry.title: Penry Williams, The Later Tudors: England, 1547–1603, p.40 Map 6
new_source_registry.review: Google Books catalogue confirms p40 preview listing; searchable book excerpt confirms Map 6 main garrisons and caution that garrisons are not imposition of English governance; do not digitize book cartography
reliable_for: distinguish strategic intentions and effective civil administration
not_reliable_for: year-end military control area polygon without independent sources

new_source_registry.title: Siege of Haddington Research Group, The Letham Gun Platform – Preliminary Site Visit, September 2022
new_source_registry.review: Full 35-page PDF directly inspected including printed p4 figure1 and p26 conclusions: hypothetical garrison influence circle and planned forts, negative survey evidence for confirmed 16th century military occupation
not_reliable_for: proof that entire line to Edinburgh secure

new_source_registry.title: National Library of Scotland, Chris Fleet, Scotland: Defending the Nation – Mapping the Military Landscape (2018)
new_source_registry.review: Exact NLS text read: Richard Lee, Thomas Petit, John Elder, contemporary Eyemouth plan, earliest regional distance maps
reliable_for: historic military maps existence and search targets
not_reliable_for: automatic GPS-ready line for 1548 occupied land

new_source_registry.title: British Library Cotton MS Augustus I ii 56, Edinburgh assault plan, probably Richard Lee
new_source_registry.review: BL catalogue confirms shelfmark, probable Richard Lee attribution; ?1544 at Exeter British Town Maps catalogue
reliable_for: Edinburgh attack planning at city scale
not_reliable_for: 1548 east Lothian English year-end occupation polygons

new_source_registry.title: RCAHMS, Seventh Report and Inventory of Monuments and Constructions in County Dumfries (1920) historical summary
new_source_registry.review: Old transcription indexed: Dumfriesshire apparently all English on paper 1547; Castlemilk and Lochwood garrisoned while Caerlaverock and Lochmaben stayed Scottish then; royal assurances != occupation

new_source_registry.title: Historic Environment Scotland, Broughty Castle Statement of Significance
new_source_registry.review: Official HES Broughty Castle Statement of Significance, p17: February 1550 French-Scottish artillery seized Balgillo Hill English new fort 800m north; Broughty garrison capitulated following day. Strong month-year HES evidence; day number not supplied by this document.

new_source_registry.title: Seshat Global History Databank, Cliopatria GeoJSON date-ranged polity dataset
new_source_registry.review: Actual upstream LICENSE.md fetched by GitHub: CC BY 4.0; polity polygons date ranges 3400BCE–2024CE coarse independent of wartime actual control
not_reliable_for: every single year's surveyed precise boundaries

new_source_registry.title: CShapes 2.0, ETH Zurich; Library of Congress archival downloadable GIS dataset
new_source_registry.review: LOC confirms 1886–2019 independent and dependent territorial polygons GeoJSON/CSV/SHP; not earlier 1500–1885, licence conditions of actual dataset to be reverified per download

new_source_registry.title: OpenHistoricalMap historical OSM-like temporally labelled geographic database
new_source_registry.review: Official licence CC0 by default, individual third-party ways may have tagged CC BY or BY-SA; coverage incomplete and cannot infer no garrison from absent way
reliable_for: targeted forts and sites when source/date independently verified
not_reliable_for: fully complete precise 1500-present continuous empire GIS

new_source_registry.title: Laurence White, history-atlas (Cliopatria-powered interactive world map)
new_source_registry.review: GitHub repo now public for code & methods; earlier colleague's implication that all code is non-open should be revised; must inspect upstream code license before reuse
reliable_for: year-slicing and cartographic data pipelines as technical reference
not_reliable_for: independent Tudor fort site control evidence
